description.blurb: S/2004 S 26 is the outermost known natural satellite of Saturn, discovered in 2004 and announced in 2019.
description.more: S/2004 S 26 is about 4 kilometres in diameter, and orbits Saturn in 1627.18 days (the only satellite known to take over 4 years to orbit Saturn), at an inclination of 171° to the ecliptic, in a retrograde direction and with an eccentricity of 0.165.
